packages/web/src/app/api/skills/[id]/artifact/route.ts:64-75 hashes complete ZIP bytes and exposes that hash as the ETag.

collisionAudit.distinction: The existing page checks one response checksum. This intent owns repeatability across separately generated responses for unchanged inputs.

candidates.title: Test Skill Download Header Injection
candidates.exactQuestion: How should the artifact route encode publisher-controlled slug and version values before placing them in Content-Disposition and custom headers?
repoEvidence: packages/web/src/app/api/skills/[id]/artifact/route.ts:69-75 interpolates row.slug and currentVersion into response header values.
packages/web/src/app/api/skills/route.ts:14 and 22 constrain only maximum lengths for custom slug and version values.

collisionAudit.distinction: The existing article owns correct response metadata. This intent owns hostile filename and version characters at the HTTP header boundary.
